summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of renaming an unnamed index by restoring the old auto-generated name during the backward operation, which resolves the crash. However, there are some concerns about the approach.

issues.description: The approach assumes that `get_index_by_name` will always find the index by name, which might not be the case if the index was not properly created or named. This could lead to errors or unexpected behavior.
The comment could be more descriptive to explain why the backward operation needs to restore the old auto-generated name, improving readability.
